rationale: C04 is the strongest drafting-template candidate. Issued only a year earlier, it supplies a nearly identical sequence of operative provisions and unusually close language: proclamation and mapped reservation of federal lands; withdrawal from public-land, mining, and mineral-leasing laws; reservation of non-federal lands upon federal acquisition; management by Interior through BLM as part of the National Landscape Conservation System; the same designated-road-and-trail vehicle restrictions; Indian-rights and state-jurisdiction savings clauses; dominant-reservation language; and the same warning. C02 is also materially relevant because it established the very monument being enlarged and supplied both factual language and much of the underlying administrative framework, but C04 more closely matches the child’s updated Obama-era wording and full operative arrangement. C08 is a strong contemporary parallel but lacks the direct monument-specific connection of C02 and is less textually close than C04.

shared_material.child_excerpt: hereby proclaim the objects identified above that are situated upon lands and interests in lands owned or controlled by the Government of the United States to be part of the California Coastal National Monument and, for the purpose of protecting those objects, reserve as a part thereof all lands and interests in lands ... within the boundaries described on the accompanying map
shared_material.parent_excerpt: hereby proclaim the objects identified above that are situated upon lands and interests in lands owned or controlled by the Government of the United States to be the San Juan Islands National Monument ... and, for the purpose of protecting those objects, reserve as a part thereof all lands and interests in lands ... within the boundaries described on the accompanying map
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive, closely parallel proclamation-and-reservation language adapted from establishing a monument to enlarging one.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The establishment of the unit is subject to valid existing rights. Lands and interests in lands within the unit boundaries not owned or controlled by the Government of the United States shall be reserved as a part of the unit upon acquisition of ownership or control by the United States.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The establishment of the monument is subject to valid existing rights. Lands and interests in lands within the monument boundaries not owned or controlled by the Government of the United States shall be reserved as a part of the monument upon acquisition of ownership or control by the Secretary of the Interior ... on behalf of the United States.
shared_material.explanation: Nearly identical automatic-reservation machinery for later-acquired lands.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Secretary of the Interior shall manage the unit through the Bureau of Land Management as part of the National Landscape Conservation System, pursuant to applicable legal authorities, to protect the objects identified above.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Secretary shall manage the monument through the BLM as a unit of the National Landscape Conservation System, pursuant to applicable legal authorities, to implement the purposes of this proclamation
shared_material.explanation: The same agency, conservation-system placement, legal-authority formula, and protective purpose.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Except for emergency or authorized administrative purposes, motorized vehicle use in the unit shall be permitted only on designated roads, and non-motorized mechanized vehicle use shall be permitted only on roads and trails designated for their use.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Except for emergency, Federal law enforcement, or authorized administrative purposes, motorized vehicle use in the monument shall be permitted only on designated roads, and non-motorized mechanized vehicle use in the monument shall be permitted only on designated roads and trails.
shared_material.explanation: Near-verbatim vehicle-use restriction, with only a minor omission and stylistic adjustment.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Nothing in this proclamation shall be deemed to enlarge or diminish the rights of any Indian tribe. ... Nothing in this proclamation shall enlarge or diminish the jurisdiction or authority of the State of California, including its jurisdiction and authority with respect to fish and wildlife management.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Nothing in this proclamation shall be deemed to enlarge or diminish the rights of any Indian tribe. ... Nothing in this proclamation shall be deemed to enlarge or diminish the jurisdiction of the State of Washington with respect to fish and wildlife management.
shared_material.explanation: Parallel savings provisions appear in the same operative framework, adapted to California.
